New Pre-Civilization Egypt Release in 24 hours!
The game focuses on the period from the beginning of the Neolithic in Upper Egypt in 5000 BC until the advent of the state in the year 3000 BC.

Fixes in Russian, English and Spanish texts.

notes.title: Version 2.8.6 -Changed the mechanism of stats count + some bugfixes
notes.notes:
Changed the mechanism for stats modifiers. Now modifiers do not apply to the whole stat, but for each source of stat alone (production in the city, trade, etc.). Each modifier are now charges only if the increase of the stat’s source is positive. It fixes a number of strange bugs found in events or trade. For example, if there is a bonus + 50% production and you try to sell it, than the number sold production also increased by 50%.
Increased precision of the stats for large numbers - rounding occurs to smaller digit, to avoid the some problematic situations. For example, when production number written is sufficient for the construction, but you cannot build it.
Changed window for stat description details. The effects of events, technologies, and exploration are now give only the bonuses that they generate, plus added other bonuses that generated by events and technologies, such as bonus from Byzantium, technology Philosopher's Stone, Colossus, etc.
Small changes in the German text.
Fixed a bug due to which after the construction of Level 1 Houses, there was a text in description that building requires one gold for maintenances, but maintenance was free.
Fixed a bug with sound and music icons status in main menu, when icons remained unchanged, even when sound and music were switched off in the options during the game.


Версия 2.8.6 - изменен механизм подсчета статов + исправлены некоторые ошибки
Переделан механизм начисления модификаторов для статов. Теперь модификаторы применяются не ко всему стату, а для каждого источника стата в отдельности (производство в городе, торговля и т.п.). И теперь каждый модификатор начисляются только если прирост источника стата положительный. Это исправляет ряд странных багов, встречающихся в событиях или торговле. Например, если есть бонус +50% к приросту продукции и попробовать продавать её, то кол-во продаваемой продукции так же увеличивалось на 50%.
Повышена точность отображения статов, для больших цифр округление происходит в меньшую сторону что бы не было ситуации, когда, например, продукции написано, что достаточно для постройки, а построить нельзя.
Переработаны окно описание деталей статов. Эффекты от событий, технологий и разведки теперь дают только те бонусы, которые они сами генерируют, плюс в них же добавлены другие вещи, которые генерирует события и технологии, например, Бонус от Византии, технологии Философского камня, Колосса и т.п.
Небольшие правки в Немецких текстах.
Исправлен баг из-за которого после постройки домов 1-го уровня было описание что дома требуют 1 золото на содержание, хотя содержания не требовалось.
Исправлен баг, что в главном меню не обновлялось состояние иконок звука и музыки даже в ситуации, когда состояние звука и музыка были изменены в опциях во время игры.

Fixed bug where trade Level 2 did not add +30% to a maximum tax collectors.

 Paradigm "Rich copper mines" was weakened, the population growth penalty is now 10% (was 5%), and the military and industrial bonuses are 25% (was 30%).

notes.title: Version 2.6 - screen optimization, additional turns + trading cards (soon!)
notes.notes:
Version 2.6


Added the possibility to continue playing after winning the game. You will not be able to play this game in Sandbox mode like in "Bronze Age", but you will have enough time to finish the things you would like to.

Optimization of the game screen. For resolutions where the game starts with black blocks on the edges, now inserted Greek ornament.

Fixed bug when after the unification of Greece player chose to play as the Spartan kingdom, the quest line was for Athens. Now it’s for Sparta as it must be normally.

The player now receives 1 trader back whenever he breaks trade route with any city.

The Plague growth rate weakened for easy mode by 50% and for normal mode by 25%.

The total amount if the Roman troops now less by 25% for normal and easy modes.

Athens possible total amount of envoys increased by 25% for both maps.

The requirements for the settlers players have to meet (for Sparta) in the last part of game are decreased and it is now much easier to unite the world.

Fixed bug when, in some situations, an independent city or the country on the map had a Player’s flag.

Fixed bug when Pella did not help to repel the Persians, sending only 20% of its forces when was allied with player (But the Persian forces were also increased by approximately 500 warriors).

Fixed bug when conversion to Christianity was successful even with 0% chance (1% chance remained).

Fixed bug when after the failed attack on the Scythians, counted as trial failure, but the “Scythians Invasion” still remained as debuff.

Trade cards and badges are ready for Steam review.

Several typos fixes in Russian and English versions of the text.

notes.title: Version 2.5 Update (Mac version + player wishes + fixes)
notes.notes:
Version 2.5

Major change
 The Mac version of the game is available for Steam users.

Fixed bugs. 

 Playing as Sparta under the Roman’s rule, if the player survived till the Fall of the Roman Empire, all of the previous tasks will be properly cancelled.
 If player cancels a counter-attack against the Huns, it does not lead to failure of the trial. 
 If the player tried to sell the warriors he did not own – trade rout was broken. Now trading breaks only if he sells more than 0 warriors he did not have.
 Fixed bug «impossible to change the name of the ruler in full screen mode».


Players’ wishes

 Rebalanced culture costs for Techs after 25 level, the latest technology now cost less (not “millions” as before).
 During the Plague even, all attacks against him stopped. All “grudge-hate” relations are increasing to 3. At the end of the Plague, all other cities also lose 25% of the population.
 Added “Quit game” in main menu.
 Disabled ESC button function in full screen mode, to prevent the “black box” situation.


Other fixes

 “Quit game” button in options menu renamed to “Save and Exit”.
 Change the order of buttons in the options.
 Fixed a couple of typos in Russian version of the game.
